0.reason: the stale carrier only causes a needless refresh (a cost, never a wrong reuse), selective refresh is opt-in, and the fixed-shape bank route does not vary geometry along a chain

1.reason: import placement under the file's existing E402 suppression; style only

findings.text: the returned decision keeps the carried decision's cell_vertices, cell_vertex_count, cell_centre and cell_pitch while its fragment areas were evaluated on the supplied geometry, so a chain that ever varies geometry records a carrier its refreshed cells were not built on — the next read at that geometry refreshes needlessly, and a decision so returned that is later applied back to the original geometry would reuse fragments computed on the other one, which is the defect this node removed. No current caller varies geometry (nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:441 passes a fixed operands.geometry with reuse=False), so the repair is one _replace argument.

from dataclasses import replace sits after the module-level configure_dtypes() call and relies on the file-wide ruff E402 suppression rather than the stdlib-first order the rest of the module's imports use, so a narrowing of that suppression breaks the file.
